result.topic_en: Gauss computes the cubic equation for the three four-term periods of the 13th roots of unity (citing Roger Cotes), evaluates the numerical values of the periods, and extracts a square root to obtain differences of two-term sums.

methods.what: Recurrence identity for elementary symmetric sums: difference of sums over two index sets, divided by (b−a), gives a lower-order symmetric sum
methods.quote: $\left(\underset{(b,c,d\ldots n)}{\Sigma\, 1.2.3\ldots p} - \underset{(a,b,\ldots m)}{\Sigma\, 1.2.3\ldots p}\right) : (b-a) = \underset{(a.b\ldots n)}{\Sigma\, 1\ldots p-1}$

methods.what: Cubic period equation whose roots are the three four-term Gaussian periods of the 13th roots of unity
methods.quote:
für $x^{13}-1=0$ die erste Gleichung
$A^3+AA-4A+1$ davon die Wurzeln

methods.what: Numerical values of the three four-term periods (sums of roots of unity indexed by exponents)
Squaring a difference of two-term sums and expressing the result in terms of the periods
Digit-by-digit extraction of a square root by long hand
Combining the square root with a period value by addition and subtraction to obtain the two-term sums, then halving
